milestone.title: mp autopilot design-input migration — move mp-herdr-log design input into master-plan and ship `mp autopilot design-input` (per R15)

intent.outcome: Substantive lessons from the autopilot design-input section in mp-herdr-log.txt are queryable through `mp autopilot design-input show <topic>` and discoverable in the plan zone, not lost when a repo-root log file gets truncated.

problem.description: mp-herdr-log.txt:328-339 (R15 — log file fragility): the repo-root log file has been truncated multiple times during the autopilot test runs. The future Drive milestone (now folded into M207-M229) was supposed to migrate the orchestration log INTO master-plan/ as a structured record queryable via `mp autopilot design-input`. The lessons themselves were consumed by M207-M229, but the durable record was never built — mp-herdr-log.txt still sits at the repo root and remains a single-source-of-truth-loss risk. The user has now asked us to remove the log files in this audit pass; the design-input lessons must move into the plan zone first, otherwise we lose them.

in_scope: Define a JSON schema for an autopilot design-input record (e.g., `master-plan/decisions/M-autopilot-design-input.json`, or per-decision files under `master-plan/decisions/autopilot/`).

Write a one-time migration script (or `mp autopilot design-input sync` subcommand) that ingests mp-herdr-log.txt and mp-herdr-log2.txt's substantive sections (the R1-R15 hard requirements from mp-herdr-log.txt and the cross-session lessons in mp-herdr-log2.txt's 'Lessons carried forward' / 'New lessons' / 'Forward-looking' sections) into the structured records.
Add `mp autopilot design-input show <topic>` and `mp autopilot design-input list` subcommands that read the structured records and return JSON / pretty output.

Add 5+ integration tests that load the canonical topics (e.g., `lane-notification`, `cycle-matrix`, `role-boundaries`, `commit-strategy`, `m202-doc-lint`) and assert the structured content matches the original.

Only AFTER the migration is verified: delete mp-herdr-log.txt and mp-herdr-log2.txt from the repo root and add them to .gitignore so re-clones don't resurrect them. Update any 'see mp-herdr-log.txt' references in code to point at the new command.
out_of_scope: Re-running the autopilot test; the design-input is one-way text-to-structured migration.
Changing the test fixture content (the lessons stay as-is; only their storage shape changes).
Adding new design-input records for M230-M238 — those are captured via the standard mp reviews / mp decisions paths and do NOT need the design-input shape.

acceptance_criteria.description: mp-herdr-log.txt and mp-herdr-log2.txt are no longer at the repo root after the migration ships; they are absent from git's tree.
acceptance_criteria.verification: test ! -e mp-herdr-log.txt && test ! -e mp-herdr-log2.txt; git ls-files | rg 'mp-herdr-log' returns nothing.

acceptance_criteria.description: Structured records exist under master-plan/decisions/ (or equivalent), one per R1-R15 topic, with content that matches the source lesson word-for-word.
acceptance_criteria.verification: ls master-plan/decisions/autopilot/ shows 15 files (matching R1..R15); a sample diff test asserts that `mp autopilot design-input show lane-notification` returns the source paragraph verbatim.

acceptance_criteria.description: mp autopilot design-input list / show subcommands return JSON; the consumer-surface-lint stays clean (these are agent-facing, must not pollute).
acceptance_criteria.verification: mp autopilot design-input list (returns ≥15 entries); mp autopilot design-input show lane-notification returns the R4 paragraph; make consumer-surface-lint.

acceptance_criteria.description: Integration test ingests a fixture of the original log sections and round-trips through the new command; lossless migration is provable.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_design_input --no-fail-fast; the test feeds a fixture of the original text and asserts the structured record bytes match the source.

acceptance_criteria.description: make test remains green; an existing repo-root reference (e.g., a CHANGELOG line or skill body that said 'see mp-herdr-log.txt') now points at the new command.
acceptance_criteria.verification: make test; rg -n 'mp-herdr-log' templates/ docs/ scripts/ crates/ (after migration must be empty or point at the design-input command).

work_packages.name: CLI plus tests plus cleanup
work_packages.goal: Ship the design-input command; prove lossless migration; delete repo-root logs

work_packages.name: Schema and sync
work_packages.goal: Define the design-input JSON schema; ingest mp-herdr-log.txt and mp-herdr-log2.txt into structured records

steps.action: Define the JSON schema and ingest the source lessons into per-topic records under master-plan/decisions/autopilot/.
Add the lossless round-trip integration test that feeds the source fixture and asserts the structured record matches verbatim; ensure suite passes.

Remove mp-herdr-log.txt and mp-herdr-log2.txt from the repo root and add them to .gitignore; update any external references that name them; run full test plus consumer-surface-lint plus plan-validate.
steps.tests: test ! -e mp-herdr-log.txt; test ! -e mp-herdr-log2.txt; git ls-files | rg mp-herdr-log returns nothing; rg mp-herdr-log templates docs scripts crates returns nothing; make test; make consumer-surface-lint; mp validate

steps.action: Remove mp-herdr-log.txt plus mp-herdr-log2.txt from the repo root; update .gitignore plus any external references.
steps.tests: test ! -e mp-herdr-log.txt; test ! -e mp-herdr-log2.txt; git ls-files | rg mp-herdr-log returns nothing; rg mp-herdr-log in templates docs scripts crates is empty; make test; make consumer-surface-lint; mp validate
